lines.lights_out: Lights out, lights out! Clean start. Tyres are cold, careful into turn one.
lines.lights_out_wet: Lights out! It's slippery out there, easy on the throttle.
lines.fastest_lap: That's the fastest lap. Mega, mega.
lines.track_limits: Track limits. Keep it inside the white lines.
lines.track_limits_last: That's your last warning for track limits.
lines.penalty: We have a five second penalty. Push now, we need to pull a gap.
lines.pit_good: Good stop, good job boys. New tyres, bring them in gently.
lines.pit_out: Out of the pits. Push now, push.
lines.wing_damage: Front wing damage, front wing damage. Box this lap, box this lap.
lines.contact_damage: Contact. We've got damage on the car, we're checking. Keep it on the road.
lines.contact_ok: Contact. We see no damage, keep going.
lines.fire: Stop the car, stop the car! Get out, get out now!
lines.retired: That's it, the car's too badly damaged. Bring it to a stop. Sorry mate.
lines.vsc: Virtual safety car, V S C. Stay above the delta, no overtaking.
lines.vsc_ending: V S C ending. Get ready, get the tyres warm.
lines.blue_flags: Blue flags. Let them through on the straight.
lines.drs: D R S enabled. You're within a second.
lines.leading: You're leading the race! Leading the race.
lines.nice_move: Nice move! Great job, keep going.
lines.lost_place: Lost a place. Stay close for D R S.
lines.defend: He's right on your gearbox. Defend, defend.
lines.attack: Gap is closing. You've got him, go for it.
lines.battery_low: Battery is low. Lift and coast a little, it recharges on the brakes.
lines.rain_heavy: Rain is here, and it is heavy. Careful.
lines.rain_stop: Rain has stopped. The line will start to dry.
lines.rain_soon: Radar shows rain in a few minutes.
lines.tyres_worn: The tyres are going off. Box this lap.
lines.box_compound: We still have to run a second compound. Box, box.
lines.box_inters: Box for inters, box for inters.
lines.box_wets: Box for full wets, it's getting worse.
lines.box_slicks: Track is drying. Box for slicks this lap.
lines.win: Yes! Yes! P one! You've won it! Unbelievable job today!
lines.podium: Podium! Great job today, great job.
lines.points: Good job. That's points today, well done.
lines.finish: Chequered flag. That's the end of the race, bring it back in.
lines.gap_close: The car behind is closing. Keep it clean.
